caption:
Most service ads lose the sale before anyone calls.

The ad skips straight to 'call now' without earning the click first.

The fix is a 4-part trust stack:

1. Name the exact problem
2. Show one piece of real evidence
3. Spell out what happens after they click
4. Remove every reason to hesitate

Run your next ad through these four. See what's missing.
